basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 6E at Union House, a newly constructed luxury condo development featuring 41 exquisite residences. Nestled in the coveted Pacific Heights neighborhood of San Francisco, this spectacular 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home spans 1,871 sq ft and stands as one of the largest and final available options in the building. The main living area showcases an open and expansive kitchen, living, and dining room layout, which seamlessly extends to an outdoor terrace offering breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Palace of Fine Arts, and the San Francisco Bay. Residence 6E is one of the last remaining 3-bedroom homes in this highly desirable, upscale building. Union House offers a secure environment with a full-time lobby attendant and restricted elevator access, ensuring peace of mind. Additionally, the home includes convenient parking for one car.
